title: GPS-BLOCK-NATIVE: a streamed native pair instrument with linear classical storage

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2N), the ONE GPS-BLOCK-NATIVE physical implementation in proof.md executes the complete GPS-BLOCK logical program of gps-source.md with identical output channel, private-sign/extraction erasure, low-residue routing, four literal hard cutoffs, original acquisition schedule and full finite n<256 branch. Under the exact canonical independent-ideal-copy promise it recovers the ENTIRE s with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8. Every generated bit/gate/measurement, field fetch, full address, source move, initialization, padding/inactive cell, failed attempt and complete output-first cleanup is counted on EVERY branch. The direct interpreter stages only bounded address fields and maps already-classical data to measured basis cells, never a coherent quantum query address. No QRAM, free word arithmetic, source inverse/control, purification, instruction oracle or arbitrary phase primitive is used. ALL FIVE guarantees hold JOINTLY for this SAME actual implementation. Charged sequential time is O(n^(5/2)(log2n)^(3/2) 2^((176777/250000)sqrt(n log2n))), exact growth index1/2. The complete native ATTEMPT, including all SEARCH/clock/verification/residue/diffusion/pair-projection/compression/failure work, costs O(R^2 L w_i) with the original pre-debited sum of weights capped by Wcap. Generic source/label/decoder/frame/mode work is explicitly polynomial in n times Qcap+q0+1, and the proved for-every-fixed-A bounds Qcap,q0=O(n^(-A)2^R) absorb that overhead. No generic callback or full-label scan occurs per Grover iteration. The original exact R-profile and all source caps are unchanged. This is a worst-case-branch bound, not an expected runtime. For n<2^4096 the COMPLETE prior BANK2 physical program is used. The large branch precomputes one residue matrix per admitted node, streams known coefficient rows without measuring query addresses, and uses a fixed number of native active O(n)-bit words. Full-reference hybrid mode/channel equality preserves the original output law with zero extra failure.
